# Traders Expo Johannesburg

Traders Expo Johannesburg is Africa's premier exhibition and conference for online trading, fintech and financial markets, organised by ProFX Media FZ-LLC.

## Event facts

- Dates: 19–20 February 2027 (two full days)
- Venue: Emperors Palace, Centre Court, 64 Jones Road, Kempton Park, Johannesburg, South Africa
- Organiser: ProFX Media FZ-LLC
- Contact: info@profxmedia.com · media & sponsorship +971 58 553 1033 · profxexpo.com
- Expected audience: 4,000+ traders (sponsorship brochure)
- Tickets: free — reserve with name, email and mobile number; the ticket is emailed to you
- Previous edition: ProFX Expo Africa, Cape Town, 20–21 August 2026, CTICC 2 Exhibition Hall 5; participating companies included GTCFX and Leverage Markets
- Sponsorship: eight tiers from $4,000 (Silver) to $30,000 (Title); branding add-ons from $250 (advertising banner) to $10,000 (Speaker Hall)

## Program highlights

- Exhibition floor: brokers, fintech companies, trading platforms, payment providers
- Two-day conference: keynotes, panels, workshops on trading strategy, platforms and risk
- Live trading contest across both days — staged by ProFX Media FZ-LLC, the official Guinness World Records™ title holders for the most participants in a trading competition
- Awards night: the Traders Expo Johannesburg Awards, gala on the evening of 19 February 2027
- Networking: meetups, influencers, deal-making
